    DOS Helper Core
    DOS-ready block generator. This does not replace the official Design of Service; it prepares pump schedule tables, N₂ calculation tables, chemical/material summaries and copy-ready blocks for faster DOS preparation.
    Copy-to-DOS Print-safe tables Helper output only
    Pump Schedule Builder
    Enter the operational stage values. CT speed is an input; stage time, cumulative time, interval and estimated passes are outputs.
    Show working
    Add a stage to show calculation basis.
    Appendix H / Chemical Tables
    Generates individual DOS-style chemical requirement tables before the final total summary: pickling, brine, non-acid preflush, acid preflush when required, main treatment, post-flush / CT displacement, neutralization if active, and total requirement.
    Chemical Governance / Report Naming
    Internal mode keeps all working names. Dual mode shows trade/product names with their functional description. Protected mode masks selected trade/product names in copied Appendix H tables, Job Package exports, and report tables. Common chemicals such as HCl 33%, NH₄Cl, ABF, Soda Ash and Base Water remain unchanged.
    Show Appendix H notes
    Refresh tables to show included sections and duplicate-control notes.
    DOS-Style N₂ Lift Calculation Table
    Converts the current N₂ Calculator result into a DOS-style table similar to the formal Design of Service format.
    Show working
    Calculate N₂ lift first to show calculation basis.
    Job Package / Report Builder
    Central report center for calculated CT job sections. Run any calculator, then return here to review, select, and export one official job package.
    Report Details
    Global Report Protection
    Protected mode replaces selected trade/product names with functional descriptions in report/export outputs. Common chemicals such as HCl 33%, NH₄Cl, ABF, Soda Ash and Base Water remain unchanged.
